intent.caption: Pedestal material study — A cinematic-floor pedestal with a torus-knot material study: brushed metal PBR, contact shadow, imperfection pass.

visualSpec.effects: Torus knot (radius 0.7, tube 0.22, 220 x 36 segments) centered at [0,0.4,0] above a cylindrical pedestal radius 1.1, height 0.5, top face at y=-0.35. Knot material: brushed-metal PBR, roughnessMap /prism-assets/chrome/brushed-metal.map.png injected with center 0.9 (map multiplies, swap-proof), base roughness 0.55, metalness 0.55, clearcoat 0.22, clearcoatRoughness 0.35, anisotropy 0.9 rotated 90 deg to the tube direction. Imperfection pass: scratch-noise normal map at strength 0.15, plus 2 percent value jitter on roughness so highlights break up. Pedestal: #14141a, roughness 0.7, metalness 0.35, 0.03-unit chamfered top edge catching the key light. Contact shadow: radial gradient plane radius 1.5 units at y=-0.36, center opacity 0.6 falling to 0 over 0.4 units. Environment: neutral studio PMREM IBL at intensity 0.7 so the brushed anisotropy streaks read. Backdrop 7 x 6-unit plane at z=-3 with the vertical gradient stops. Orbit on load: knot rotates about y at 0.1 rad/s, camera drifts on radius 0.4; caption baseline 1.6 units below center, headline 1.2 units below center on the 0.25-unit rhythm.

sceneSpec.motionNote: The torus knot rotates slowly (0.1 rad/s) while the camera drifts on a 0.4-unit orbit; brushed highlights sweep across the anisotropic surface.
